Title: Post -> Discover -> Apply -> Chat -> Interview -> Hire
Test Steps: 1) Employer posts a job 2) Seeker finds it in /job-feed 3) Seeker applies 4) Employer sees applicant 5) Both chat 6) Employer schedules interview 7) Accept/hire
Expected Result: Full loop works across employer+seeker surfaces; each side sees the other's actions; statuses stay in sync

Title: Credit lifecycle across billing/jobs/candidates
Test Steps: 1) Buy a plan (test) 2) Post a job (spends post credit) 3) Unlock a candidate (spends download credit) 4) Check wallet + invoices
Expected Result: Wallet reflects both spends correctly on every screen; invoice matches purchase; ledger consistent

Title: Business register -> admin approve -> trial -> first post
Test Steps: 1) Register business (under review) 2) Admin approves 3) Trial credit fires on approval 4) Employer posts first job
Expected Result: Cannot post before approval; approval grants trial; first post works; spans employer+admin

Title: Invite cold-start -> shared org wallet
Test Steps: 1) Owner invites new email 2) Invitee registers fresh via /invite/token 3) Auto-accept 4) Invitee posts/unlocks
Expected Result: Invitee joins ORG; uses the ORG wallet (not own trial 1/3); spans auth+team+billing

Title: Seeker report -> admin resolve -> outcome
Test Steps: 1) Seeker reports a job 2) Admin sees it in /admin/reports 3) Admin moderates + resolves with note
Expected Result: Report flows portal->admin; resolution recorded; post moderation state reflects

Title: Search -> unlock -> chat -> interview
Test Steps: 1) Employer searches candidates 2) Unlocks one 3) Chats 4) Schedules interview 5) Seeker responds
Expected Result: Snippet->unlock->contact->conversation->interview chain works end to end

Title: Seeker deletion consistency across surfaces
Test Steps: 1) Employer unlocks seeker 2) Seeker deletes account 3) Employer views unlocked record 4) Admin views monetization
Expected Result: Contact 'no longer available' everywhere; the spend still shows in admin; no refund; no PII served post-deletion

Title: Employer soft-delete -> freeze -> restore
Test Steps: 1) Admin soft-deletes employer 2) Check credits/jobs 3) Restore (dev) 4) Re-check
Expected Result: Credits frozen not destroyed; live jobs handled; restore returns exact balances

Title: Interview -> multi-channel consistency
Test Steps: 1) Employer schedules interview 2) Observe seeker in-app + email(.ics) + WhatsApp(when configured)
Expected Result: In-app fires; email .ics attached; WhatsApp/SMS SKIPPED until configured; one channel failing doesn't block others

Title: Plan expiry -> grace -> inactivate (cron)
Test Steps: 1) Let plan expire 2) Day 0-3 check posting/unlock + live jobs 3) Day 3 cron
Expected Result: New post/unlock blocked at expiry; live jobs stay live through grace; day-3 cron inactivates; unlocked contacts retained

Title: Member posts a job, then is removed (attribution vs authz)
Test Steps: 1) Member posts a job + unlocks a candidate 2) Owner removes the member
Expected Result: Job stays live + unlock stays (attribution); no credit refunded; no CreditTransaction; re-invite reactivates same row

Title: Seat downgrade -> suspend -> owner frees -> restore
Test Steps: 1) Larger plan lapses so cap drops 2) Newest member suspended 3) Member tries to post 4) Owner removes a teammate 5) Member retries
Expected Result: Newest suspended (owner protected); member gets SEAT_SUSPENDED (NOT 'buy credits'); freeing a seat restores in invite order

Title: Admin taxonomy change reflects in both flows
Test Steps: 1) Admin adds/links a job title 2) Employer post flow shows it 3) Seeker category filter shows jobs under it
Expected Result: Taxonomy edits propagate to employer post picker AND seeker category browse

Title: Document approve -> employer rollup -> can post
Test Steps: 1) Admin verifies all docs 2) Employer verification rollup 3) Employer posts
Expected Result: Employer becomes ACTIVE when all docs approved; posting unlocks

Title: Webhook-only grant (browser closed)
Test Steps: 1) Pay 2) Close browser before client-verify 3) Razorpay webhook delivers
Expected Result: Credits still granted via webhook path; employer sees wallet updated on next load; no double grant if client-verify later runs

Title: Content scan -> review -> violation -> reporter sees outcome
Test Steps: 1) Admin scans a post 2) Marks violation 3) Reporter's report resolved
Expected Result: Scan findings inform decision; violation recorded; reporter's report closes; post state consistent

Title: Hindi across the whole seeker journey
Test Steps: 1) Set Hindi 2) Register->feed->apply->chat->interview 3) Compare status labels admin vs seeker
Expected Result: UI stays Hindi throughout, no revert; status enums localized on seeker side

Title: GST place-of-supply across two purchases
Test Steps: 1) Buy from same state 2) Buy from other state 3) Check invoices + admin monetization
Expected Result: Invoice 1 CGST+SGST, invoice 2 IGST; admin reconciliation matches to the paisa

Title: Skill deactivated -> seeker dropdown + existing links
Test Steps: 1) Admin deactivates a skill 2) New seeker profile edit 3) Existing seeker who had it
Expected Result: Hidden from the seeker dropdown; existing JobSeekerSkill preserved (not deleted)

Title: Job title deleted (global) -> live jobs + new posts
Preconditions: Live jobs use a title; admin
Test Steps: 1) Admin deletes a job title 2) Check a live job using it 3) New post picker
Expected Result: Live jobs stay valid (no orphan/break); title unavailable for new posts

Title: Two members act on the shared wallet simultaneously
Test Steps: 1) Both members unlock/post at the same time near the credit limit
Expected Result: Wallet stays consistent; no oversell; exactly the available credits spent (bridges to system-design suite)

Title: Employer edits live job -> seeker sees update
Test Steps: 1) Employer edits a live job 2) Seeker re-opens it
Expected Result: Seeker sees updated details; existing applications intact; edit free

Title: Admin adds employer individual -> trial -> login
Test Steps: 1) Admin adds an individual employer (both OTPs) 2) Employer logs in
Expected Result: OWNER membership + trial credit present; employer wallet shows trial

Title: Failed payment -> retry -> success
Test Steps: 1) Pay (fail) 2) Confirm no credits 3) Retry (success)
Expected Result: No credits on failure; no orphan order; retry grants once

Title: Admin action -> audit log + per-entity history
Test Steps: 1) Admin approves/deletes something 2) Check global audit log 3) Open entity History panel
Expected Result: Action recorded in global feed (SUPER_ADMIN) and per-entity trail (any admin)

Title: Google OAuth end-to-end (both roles)
Test Steps: 1) Seeker signs in with Google 2) Employer signs in with Google
Expected Result: Both roles authenticate via /auth/google/login
Notes: Blocked - OAuth client ID not configured on deploy

Title: Two-user chat real-time-ish (polling)
Test Steps: 1) Both open the thread 2) Exchange messages 3) Read receipts
Expected Result: Messages appear via polling within interval; order + read receipts consistent both sides

Title: Job expiry removes from feed + application state
Test Steps: 1) Let a job expire 2) Seeker feed 3) Existing applicants
Expected Result: Expired job leaves active feed; existing applications retain history; apply blocked

Title: Report -> repeated abuse -> deactivate/delete
Test Steps: 1) Multiple reports 2) Admin warns 3) Violation 4) Deactivate/delete
Expected Result: Escalation path works; hard-delete cascades; reporters' reports resolvable

Title: Read-your-writes after a cross-surface action
Test Steps: 1) Employer posts a job 2) Immediately load admin moderation queue
Expected Result: New post appears in admin queue (or documented eventual-consistency window); no stale read that misleads moderation
